newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Hermis features as Lithuanian share volume leaps.
newsitem.headline: Hermis features as Lithuanian share volume leaps.

text.p: Shares on the Lithuanian stock exchange gained strongly on Thursday with Hermis Bank making up most of the business, dealers said.
Overall central market trade came to 1.8 million litas while the group A share index rose by 21.45 points to 1,874.05.
Hermis Bank, one of the top three banks, turned over 1.02 million litas of shares and rose to 205 litas from 200.
Lithuanian Gas was unchanged at 1.55 litas on trade of 430,887 litas and Birzai Milk rose to 8.2 from eight litas on business of 187,476 litas.
TV screens maker Ekranas made the highest gain of the day on trade of 67,692 litas and rose to three litas from 2.58 litas.
Bloc trades worth 227,270 litas were carried out with Birzai Milk featuring on 82,000 litas of turnover at a price of 8.2 litas while Lithuanian Gas made trade of 83,270 litas at 1.55.
Volume on the secondary T-bill market was 806,305 litas.
